title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Google's strongest AI, locked

post.caption:
Google's strongest AI… and you can't use it 🔒

Gemini 4 Carbon finds, validates and patches security flaws. The same skills could help attackers, so Google is giving it to vetted cyber-defenders first.

Should AI this powerful stay locked? Tell me 👇
Follow: I'll test it the day it opens.
